resources.string: Uses LINE accessibility content only to locate and visually mask the LINE VOOM promotional banner in Chats. No data is stored or transmitted.
Masks the LINE VOOM promotional banner shown between Search and your first chat. It does not remove or reflow LINE content.
Accessibility access is used only to find and mask this promo banner while LINE is on screen. No content or personal data is stored or transmitted.
LINE is not installed or cannot be opened.
